single_variable: Keep all 10,000 positive images and labels byte-identical and expand only the paired negative count from 10,000 to 30,000.

owner_authorization.quote: 对啊 那你应该搞3w张啊
owner_authorization.interpretation: Build a replacement dataset version containing the unchanged 10,000 accepted weak positives plus 30,000 automatically mined negatives. This authorizes dataset materialization only, not training, holdout access, promotion or production use.

positive_source.positive_contract: Use every accepted source window and exact accepted box unchanged. Re-render a clean chart from pinned OHLCV and require drawing the accepted red box to recreate the delivered review PNG byte-for-byte.

lineage_baseline.required_matches: All 10,000 predecessor positives and all 10,000 seed negatives must retain exact image SHA and label SHA in v2. The additional 20,000 negatives are new rows.

renderer.positive_box_source: exact x/y geometry from the accepted review manifest; no shift, reboxing or resizing

split.method: global chronological cutoff over complete render-plus-label dependency intervals; never random
split.between_rules: materialize under excluded/ for lineage, but data.yaml must not expose it
split.dependency_end: max(render end, core end + 5 completed-history label bars)

negative_sampling.kind_assignment: Each positive targets two hard and one easy negative. The pinned v1 negative is retained as slot 1; two additional disjoint slots fill the remaining target kinds. If one preferred kind has no safe capacity, the other frozen safe kind may fill that slot only if the 60% hard floor still passes overall, train and val.

seed_plan.contract: Retain every v1 negative and revalidate its feature kind, split, geometry, positive guards and non-overlap before selecting new rows.

completed_no_launch_condition.atr_anchor: core_end + 2, matching the accepted retrieval family
completed_no_launch_condition.purpose: Future bars define only the safe negative label; rendered pixels remain the matched completed-history window and never cross holdout.

hard_definition.meaning: The six MAs are visually dense, but the completed move fails the launch thresholds.

easy_definition.meaning: Clearly non-dense background satisfying the same strict no-launch label.

positive_guard.strict_candidate_source: Re-run the hash-pinned accepted-family gate on every used source and guard every hit before negative selection.

negative_sampling.capacity_policy: Keep same source, symbol, calendar half-year, split, geometry, all strict-candidate guards, strict no-launch thresholds, non-overlap and no reuse. Kind ratio is soft only above the frozen 60% hard floor. Fail closed instead of crossing blocks, duplicating windows or approaching a protected positive.

sources.source_policy: Read only manifest-pinned source prefixes strictly before holdout. No fallback data source is permitted.

controls.positive_overlay_parity: 10,000/10,000 clean re-renders must recreate accepted boxed PNGs byte-for-byte after drawing the separate accepted rectangle.
controls.predecessor_byte_parity: The 10,000 positive and 10,000 seed-negative image and label SHAs must match v1 exactly.
controls.shifted_box_null: On a deterministic sample, cyclically use the next positive box; expected byte matches are zero.
controls.full_file_qa: Decode and hash every actual image; parse every positive label; require every negative label byte-empty and every input free of exact overlay-red pixels.
